question: Up 3 in the last 12 seconds, should the leader foul or defend?
answer: No clear edge: leader wins 92.7% fouling, 91.4% defending; +2.3 pp at equal time (CI -2.4 to +6.4).
findings: Same-time difference (foul minus defend): +2.3 pp (95% CI -2.4 to +6.4).
Reached OT: foul 9.6%, defend 14.3%. Lost in regulation: foul 1.8%, defend 1.6%.
Leader win rate once in OT: foul 42.9% (n=21), defend 50.4% (n=226).
method: First trailer possession per game that is live with 12 s or less, final regulation period, down 3. Foul = leader's non-shooting foul sending trailer to the line before any shot. Compared within possession-start bins (4-8, 8-12, 12+ s); outcome = game win incl. OT.
data: ESPN play-by-play via sportsdataverse, NBA, 2011-12 to 2025-26, 1,804 games.

chart.title: NBA: leader win % up 3, by seconds left at trailer possession start
chart.x_label: seconds left at possession start (bin middle; 14 = started earlier, live at 12)
